title: Promote an offline quick chat
description: Root Human only. Keeps session/native identity, cwd and history. Requires no runtime or launch claim. Idempotency is scoped to sessionId + requestId; repeat identical payload to recover. 200 complete=false means the durable promotion committed but roster import/project assignment is incomplete; retry the same request. Startup resumes unfinished receipts. Formal names retain the existing host-wide current-name uniqueness guard; scoped old-name reservations also apply. Errors: 400 invalid_request/agent_name_invalid; 404 session_not_found/project_not_found; 409 revision_conflict/not_quick_chat/quick_chat_running/project_not_active/agent_name_conflict/agent_name_reserved/ambiguous_native_identity/promotion_in_progress/request_id_payload_conflict/unsupported_quick_chat; 503 admission_busy/persistence_unavailable.
